candidate.blueprint_locator: Printed p.12, Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — evaluate appropriateness and accuracy of medication orders; prepare and administer medications using rights of medication administration; review pertinent data before medication administration
candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — medication preparation for enteral feeding tubes
candidate.educational_objective: Verify the suitability of the exact oral dosage form before crushing a medication for enteral-tube administration, with special attention to modified-release and enteric-coated products.

options.A: Whether the specific dosage form is suitable for manipulation and tube administration; some modified-release and enteric-coated products should not be crushed.
options.B: Whether the tablet is physically large, because formulation design does not affect the safety of crushing it for tube administration.
options.C: Whether enteral nutrition is infusing, because every solid oral medication becomes safe to crush while tube feeding is running.
options.D: Whether the client can taste the medication, because taste determines whether a tablet can be safely crushed for tube administration.

candidate.rationale: Before a solid dosage form is manipulated for enteral-tube administration, the nurse must determine whether that specific product is suitable for crushing or other manipulation. Evidence and enteral-medication guidance identify modified-release and enteric-coated dosage forms as common examples that may be inappropriate to crush, and inappropriate manipulation can alter drug delivery or contribute to tube problems. Tablet size, taste, or the mere presence of running nutrition does not establish that a dosage form is safe to crush.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Medication dosage forms must be evaluated for suitability before manipulation for feeding-tube administration; some oral products are inappropriate for crushing/tube delivery.
candidate.source_document_title: Developing guidance for feeding tube administration of oral medications
candidate.source_locator: Abstract — Methods/Results/Conclusion on evaluating oral medications for safe feeding-tube administration; article guidance/table assessing dosage-form suitability; references to noncrushable modified-release/enteric-coated products
candidate.source_organization: American Society for Parenteral and Enteral Nutrition (ASPEN), Journal of Parenteral and Enteral Nutrition
candidate.stem: Before crushing a solid oral medication for administration through an enteral feeding tube, what should the nurse verify first?
